newsitem.title: USA: Clinton to name Republican Cohen as defense chief.
newsitem.headline: Clinton to name Republican Cohen as defense chief.

text.p: President Bill Clinton on Thursday chose retiring Republican Senator William Cohen of Maine as his next defense secretary, White House officials said.
The officials, who spoke on condition of anonymity, said Cohen would be among a number of national security appointments Clinton would make in a 1:30 p.m. (1830 GMT) Oval Office ceremony.
Clinton, a Democrat, had pledged to consider putting a Republican in his Cabinet as a gesture towards Republicans who control both houses of Congress after he was re-elected to a second term.

Cohen, 56, is a 24-year veteran of Congress as well as a published poet and spy novelist. His career has been spent largely on defense and intelligence issues. He is known as a moderate in a party increasingly dominated by conservatives.
